development_observations.observation: Orca worktrees used local branch names under mauedgar/... while planned remote siblings were devlab/..., so workers pushed to unexpected but recoverable refs.
Long inline terminal sends were mangled; short pre-materialized launcher paths were reliable.

Direct workflow_dispatch by filename was unavailable while the new workflow existed only off the default branch; reusable workflow invocation from the synthetic private caller provided a competent qualification route.
Initial reusable runs failed because runner/remote was absent; repaired by creating the directory before request materialization, then rerun on a new exact candidate.
